_readme: One-time MDMS schema creation for the DST campaign config mirror. POST to <mdms-url>/mdms-v2/schema/v1/_create (or the env's egov-mdms-service schema create endpoint) once per environment root tenant. Internal call — dummy authToken suffices.

RequestInfo.msgId: create dst campaign report config schema

SchemaDefinitions.description: DST daily campaign reporting config, mirrored one-way from the team's Google Sheet by the dst_config_sync DAG. One entry per campaign row; data.row carries the sheet columns verbatim (all strings). Do not edit entries by hand — the sheet overwrites them on the next sync tick.

rowIdentity.description: tenant::campaignNumber (projectTypeId fallback) — stable across edits, new per campaign

deploymentGroup.description: Sheet tab / credential group this campaign belongs to (e.g. nigeria_states, togo)

row.description: The sheet row verbatim: state_name, tenant, drug_type, campaign_start, campaign_end, campaign_days, is_admin_console, campaign_number, project_type_id, project_type, cycle_index, report_times, partner_report_times, slack_channel, slack_channel_partners, target_csv, out_dir, secondary_product, task_date_field, task_campaign_filter, dose_index_filter, hfs_total, flws_total, lgas_total, active, campaign_name, google_sheet_id
